meta.title: Online Project Demo | Yopitek — Immersive Projection Showcase
meta.description: Explore Yopitek's 11 flagship projection mapping and immersive projection cases, including 2026 Taiwan Lantern Festival, C-LAB, King's Boat Museum, Banqiao Radio Station, and Lay's Cheese Waterfall.

hero.subtitle: Discover 11 selected immersive projection cases. From historical architectural facade mapping to 360° dome immersive environments, combining precise edge-blending calibration and real-time interactive sensing.

01.title: 2026 Taiwan Lantern Festival TechWorld
01.subtitle: Tech World Pavilion — Architectural & Indoor Cylinder Projection
01.description: The Tech World Pavilion is a comprehensive showcase of Yopitek's multi-scale spatial integration capabilities, delivering both large-scale outdoor architectural structure projection and indoor immersive installations. In the outdoor zone, massive scaffolding structures serve as projection canvases where multiple high-lumen projectors illuminate the entire architectural surface with dynamic nightly light spectacles. The indoor Life Pavilion features a custom cylindrical projection setup with natural blooms, life rhythms, and forest imagery at its core, enriched with bespoke designer chandeliers and LED ground accents to craft an ethereal immersive sanctuary. This case seamlessly unites the dramatic scale of outdoor projection mapping with the delicate intimacy of indoor installations.

02.title: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB)
02.subtitle: FUTURE VISION LAB — Multi-Projector Dome Edge-Blending
02.description: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB) is a premier art and technology experimental center in Taiwan exploring the frontiers of technological media and visual arts. Yopitek was commissioned for the immersive projection integration of C-LAB's iconic spherical dome venue, providing rigorous multi-projector edge-blending and geometric alignment. C-LAB's experimental sphere demands extraordinary color consistency and geometric precision across curved surfaces. Yopitek overcame curved projection alignment and geometric distortion challenges, ensuring crisp, uniform, and deeply immersive 360-degree dome imagery, demonstrating top-tier engineering prowess in international digital art venues.

03.title: Donggang King's Boat Museum
03.subtitle: King's Boat Museum — Panoramic Immersive Projection Wall
03.client: Pingtung County King's Boat Cultural Museum
03.description: Donggang King's Boat Festival is one of Taiwan's most revered intangible cultural heritages. To convey this traditional cultural devotion to contemporary audiences with visual power, Yopitek was entrusted by the museum to build an expansive circular immersive projection theater. Multiple high-lumen professional projectors were deployed in a seamless panoramic wrap, projecting rich, detail-packed traditional folk art illustrations and oceanic deities across the curved walls. Visitors standing within the space experience profound cultural resonance and visual wonder, ensuring ancestral folk rituals are preserved and celebrated through modern technology.

04.title: 2026 Taiwan Floral Tech Expo
04.subtitle: Houbi Orchid Exhibition — 64m Ultra-Wide Curved Panoramic Projection
04.description: The Houbi Orchid Exhibition is one of Taiwan's foremost international horticultural events. Yopitek produced the ultra-large curved projection for the main exhibition hall's core immersive scene. The total projection screen length exceeded 64 meters in a curved panoramic wraparound design, calibrated with multiple high-lumen projectors using precise seamless edge blending. Tropical flora, jungle ecology, and blooming botanicals flowed smoothly in a vivid dynamic spectacle. Combined with suspended art installations and carefully sculpted ambient lighting, the pavilion turned into a living tropical botanical garden.

05.title: Songshan Luminous Garden
05.subtitle: The LUMINOUS GARDEN — Baroque Garden Heritage Projection Mapping
05.description: The LUMINOUS GARDEN in Songshan Cultural and Creative Park is a signature long-running nighttime light experience. Yopitek was invited to create an immersive theater projection on the Baroque Garden historic tobacco factory facade. Using architectural geometric mapping and dynamic projection, centuries-old heritage architecture fused with modern audiovisual theatrical performance. Yopitek's team calibrated complex multi-tiered windows and textured historic masonry, overcoming outdoor ambient illumination to deliver rich, stable imagery across long seasons.

06.title: PALLADIUM Terminal
06.subtitle: PALLADIUM Terminal — 360° Sensory Immersive Experience
06.description: PALLADIUM is a century-old French outdoor exploration brand. In September 2026, PALLADIUM staged the 'Terminal' brand showcase at Taipei Zhongshan Linear Park, where Yopitek engineered a 360° multi-sensory immersive dome. The installation enveloped audiences in seamless urban streetscapes and outdoor wilderness imagery, harmonized with a 10-meter authentic indoor mist and rain environmental simulator. The event drew massive crowds, effectively reinforcing the tactical explorer spirit of the PALLADIUM × GORE-TEX® collection.

07.title: Banqiao Broadcasting Station
07.subtitle: Banqiao Broadcasting Station — 360° Full Immersive Projection Space
07.client: New Taipei City Cultural Affairs Department
07.description: Banqiao Broadcasting Station is Yopitek's flagship permanent installation, and one of the rare cultural spaces in Taiwan featuring complete 360° four-wall and floor projection coverage. The space projects enchanted forests, dynamic fireflies, and biodiversity vistas in panoramic resolution. A signature innovation is its capacity to integrate live theatrical performers into the dynamic projection field, where actors interact with real-time responsive imagery. Operating stably for multiple years, this showcase testifies to Yopitek's long-term hardware reliability and operational excellence.

08.title: Lay's Flavor & Light Exhibition
08.subtitle: Lay's Cheese Waterfall — Real-time Fluid Interactive Projection
08.description: The Lay's Flavor & Light exhibition was an unprecedented snack brand sensory showcase in Taiwan. Yopitek engineered the centerpiece attraction: the interactive 'Cheese Waterfall'. Combining high-lumen projection with real-time body tracking sensors, a golden cheese cascade flowed dynamically down the wall. As visitors touched the surface, the fluid parted smoothly around their hands, blossoming into golden potato chip butterflies accompanied by interactive floor ripples. Zero-latency tuning between sensors and projection ensured immediate, responsive magic, making it a social media sensation.

09.title: Color Taipei City Hall Mapping
09.subtitle: Color Taipei — City Hall Dynamic Facade Projection Mapping
09.client: Taipei City Department of Information and Tourism
09.description: This project utilized the entire facade of Taipei City Hall as a massive projection canvas for the 2021 'Color Taipei' pride celebrations. Yopitek conquered complex architectural geometry, aligning colonnades, porticos, and recessed window grids across multiple stories. High-lumen laser projectors synchronized via master timeline signal controllers delivered intense color saturation and razor-sharp motion graphics. Over multiple consecutive nights, tens of thousands of citizens gathered in awe, earning extensive national broadcast coverage and establishing Yopitek's leadership in civic architectural mapping.

10.title: 2024 Asia-Pacific Sustainability Expo
10.subtitle: Rong Cheng Paper Industry — 4-Wall Panoramic Eco Exhibition
10.client: Rong Cheng Paper Industry Co., Ltd.
10.description: Installed inside the Taipei World Trade Center, this four-wall immersive chamber presented Rong Cheng Paper Industry's annual sustainability narrative. All four surrounding walls synchronized in seamless panoramas depicting real-time paper recycling factories, raw pulp processing, and environmental stewardship. Within an extremely tight expo build window, Yopitek's team rapidly completed multi-projector blending and audiovisual timing, conveying the client's carbon reduction commitments to high praise from industry leaders.

11.title: Jam Hsiao Art Exhibition
11.subtitle: Jam Hsiao Art Exhibition — Multi-Screen Framed Window Projection
11.description: Designed for acclaimed singer Jam Hsiao, this intimate personal art showcase blended musical journeys, poetry, and Nordic natural landscapes. Top-mounted short-throw projectors converted gallery walls into framed scenic windows, simulating tranquil Nordic lakes and foggy mountains to recreate the artist's private creative haven. Synchronized with live grand piano performances and automated lighting cues, the installation delivered a deeply contemplative audiovisual art journey that drew wide acclaim.
